description: The zone_waste_scald hangar: a cavernous prefab of corrugated steel, its floor a map of old oil stains and tyre scuffs. Tool racks and a battered workbench line one wall; a wheeled ops desk with a bank of flight monitors faces the other. The big bay doors stand open to the west, framing the ramp and the aircraft parked out on it. It smells of avgas, hot metal and cold coffee.
name: zone_waste_scald Hangar
